title: Robots Doing Stuff #63 | Failure Recovery Montage
summary:
Why are some industrial tasks impossible to automate with traditional methods? Because real-world environments aren't perfectly repeatable. Parts shift and conditions change from cycle to cycle.

Our production-ready Physical AI enables robotic systems to adapt to these changing conditions, helping recover from unexpected situations, reduce manual intervention, and maintain throughput. In short: our policies are as tenacious as we are.

Back in June, we shared this plug insertion task achieving 99.5%+ success at a cycle time of 2.54 seconds. This week, we're showing another aspect of the same policy with a failure recovery montage.
